symptom: Every layout reports `Layout Type: Responsive` — including the Phone, Tablet, ModalPopup and native ones, 19 of the 22 Atlas ships
cause: Two faults compounding. `LayoutType` is **not on `Forms$Layout`**; it is on the content wrapper. `modelsdk/gen` nonetheless exposes `Layout.LayoutType()`, bound to a key the document does not carry, so it reads `""` — a phantom property, not a wrong key, which is why `keyaudit_test.go` does not list it. `DESCRIBE LAYOUT` then defaulted `""` to `"Responsive"`, rendering a failed read as a fact
insight: **Never default a value every real document carries** — an empty one means the read failed, and a plausible default is what hides it. `generated/metamodel` was right about the location all along (property of `PagesWebLayoutContent`/`PagesNativeLayoutContent`), so the arbiter rule held; what no source got right was the *value set*, six values splitting by platform (web: Responsive/Phone/Tablet/ModalPopup, native: Default/Popup) against two declared in gen and in the metamodel enum. Measured across all 22
